optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Application Security Engineer, Payment Card Vault
professionalSummary: Three years as an Application Security Engineer at a payments processor, leading security for a tokenisation service in scope for the card industry data security assessment. Demonstrated expertise in threat modelling, secure code review, remediation tracking, and evidence assembly for annual assessments. Holds CompTIA Security+ and completed a secure coding application security track.
experienceHighlights: Led threat modelling for every service change and performed code reviews for security defects on the tokenisation service. Remediated assessment findings with engineering, tracking closure in the security findings register. Assembled code review and threat model evidence for the annual assessment, authoring the review boundary statement. Prior experience as a software engineer on an e-commerce checkout team.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Provided a threat model, security findings register extract, and review boundary statement as part of the evidence pack for the last assessment cycle.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample confirm the candidate’s experience in application security for a tokenisation service in scope for the card industry data security assessment, including threat modelling, code review, remediation tracking, and evidence assembly. The materials do not confirm the candidate’s current CISSP certification status or the exact credential details required by the assessor.
